children: Palm oil rises in Asian trading, tracking overnight gains in soybean oil on the Chicago Board of Trade. The Indonesian Palm Oil Producers Association's projection that El Nino impact could reduce next year's output by about 5 million tons could also help support prices, AmInvestment Bank says in a note. AmInvestment Bank estimates palm oil prices to face resistance at 5,084 ringgit a ton and find support at 4,823 ringgit a ton. The Bursa Malaysia Derivatives contract for November delivery is up 92 ringgit at 4,986 ringgit a ton.(yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
